strapiBlog.title: 2,000 Homes in Masaar 2 Sharjah, Sold Out in Just 3 Hours!
strapiBlog.short_description: In a landmark moment for Sharjah’s real estate market, Masaar 2 Project has witnessed an unprecedented demand, with 2000 homes worth AED 5.6 billion sold out within just three hours of launch.

data.text:
In a landmark moment for Sharjah’s real estate market, Masaar 2 Project has witnessed an unprecedented demand, with 2000 homes worth AED 5.6 billion sold out within just three hours of launch. Developed by Arada, this rapid sell-out underscores the growing investor confidence in Sharjah's billion-dirham property developments and the continued appeal of high-quality, master-planned communities in the emirate.

Prince Khaled bin Alwaleed bin Talal, Executive Vice-Chairman of Arada, expressed confidence in the success of the new development:

"The original Masaar has been one of the UAE’s most transformative communities, seamlessly blending a forested landscape with an urban master plan, and it is no surprise to see the exceptional level of interest in Masaar 2. This also reflects the impressive strength of the Sharjah market and the wider interest in the UAE as an exceptional investment destination overall."

Masaar 2 spans 10.5 million square feet and features an urban forest concept, integrating 40,000 trees, a swimmable forest lagoon, and high-end residential units, ranging from two-bedroom townhouses to five-bedroom villas. The project has set a new benchmark with record-breaking property sales in Sharjah, with buyers queuing outside Arada’s sales centers from 2 a.m. to secure their investment in this highly sought-after community.

Ahmed Alkhoshaibi, Group CEO of Arada, highlighted the sustained interest in Masaar properties:

"The first iteration of Masaar has been one of the UAE’s most popular off-plan success stories of recent years, with both homeowners and investors alike praising the high quality of the finished homes, the good capital appreciation, and impressive return on investment. We’ve been receiving daily requests about a second Masaar project since the original version sold out, and the significant pent-up demand in the market has resulted in the record-breaking sales that we have seen today."

This overwhelming response to Sharjah’s Masaar 2 Project aligns with the Sharjah property boom 2025, driven by investor-friendly policies and the emirate’s strategic expansion of freehold developments. With the success of Masaar 2, Sharjah has reinforced its position as a prime real estate investment hub, offering strong capital appreciation and high rental yields.

For investors looking to capitalize on this thriving market, Sharjah’s Masaar 2 Project remains a compelling opportunity.
